mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer demand, proxied by HOUST, leads to higher corporate earnings expectations and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Over 20-day walk-forward, returns do not outperform a 5-day baseline by more than one standard deviation in a 95% confidence interval.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in employment (PAYEMS) coincides with reduced labor market frictions and accelerates corporate investment, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Significant underperformance in 20-day returns when PAYEMS growth exceeds 5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in the CPIAUCSL inflation rate exceeds +0.5%, the S&P 500 anticipates future rate cuts, producing a positive 60-day forward return.
failure_condition: No significant positive return in 60 days after inflation spike, or negative IC over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests supply-side constraints, prompting market pricing in of higher future profits and a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: IC < -0.1 over 20 days when INDPRO declines by > 2% in a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both demand (HOUST) and financial conditions (FEDFUNDS < 4%) amplifies risk appetite, yielding a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 5-day returns flat with no statistical edge over prior 5-day average in interaction regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment (PAYEMS) below the prior month's level triggers a technical reversal in equities, producing a negative 20-day forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not deviate from mean by more than 0.5% in a 90% CI.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% in a single month, the S&P 500 expects higher borrowing costs, resulting in a negative 60-day forward return.
failure_condition: 60-day returns beat a 30-day baseline by more than one standard deviation in a 95% CI.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) for three consecutive months indicates structural supply weakness, which the market interprets as a positive 20-day forward return.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly declines for 3 months in a row
failure_condition: No statistically significant positive return in 20 days after trigger, or IC > 0.05.
